verdict.rationale: Pipedream's per-app marketplace pages expose the remote endpoint and required headers, which covers the hosting attributes (e.g. the ClickUp page). They also list tool counts (e.g. OpenAI: 46 actions, 4 triggers), and the docs state the transport (SSE and streamable HTTP, served remotely), so a developer can review much of a listed server before connecting. However, there is no evidence that per-tool input schemas or full tool definitions can be browsed before connecting; tools load only after the client connects (mcpClient.tools()). Missing for 10: pre-connection per-tool input schema inspection, detailed per-tool listings beyond counts, and independent corroboration.
